QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Deep Into the Jungle
QuestInfo.0: Corine says she is the last of the Krakians. Speak with her to find out more.
QuestInfo.1: Corine asks you to defeat the Jungle Bug monsters that are threatening the relics of her ancestors.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Jungle Bug monsters for Corine.

mob.0: If we just leave those bugs to do their thing, over time, Masteria may literally see its history ground into dust. That's why I want you to eliminate 100 of the Jungle Bugs you'll find flying around the jungle.
